promoted_gamma_recipe: Gamma .995 selected from 50M validation-only screening; three fresh 200M seeds. Fresh runs use the full-budget learning-rate schedule. Held-out tests do not select recipes.

protocol.transition_count_note: Ignored NEXT_STEP reset slots are excluded by each run valid_transition counter; BC samples are additional.
protocol.frozen_test_protocol: No model or hyperparameter choice based on test seeds.
protocol.budget_rationale: Requested 200,000,000 slots, 762 complete PPO updates. Main 200M budget is 10-20 times historical budgets; compare complete validation histories and separately specified recipes, retaining regressions. Finite-budget evidence, without a global upper-bound claim.

metric_definitions.rmse: Only valid samples from each world's first episode; failures included, reset episodes excluded.
metric_definitions.last_second_rmse: Each first episode's final observed second, including shortened failed episodes.
metric_definitions.success: No termination, complete 10 s horizon, final observed second per-world RMSE < 0.10 (Figure8 < 0.15); Landing also speed RMSE < 0.10 m/s.
metric_definitions.sample_budget: Vector-step slots count API slots; valid transitions exclude NEXT_STEP reset slots; BC samples separate.
metric_definitions.comparability: Historical baseline is reevaluated on the same test seeds/initial states; historical published cross-reset RMSE is not compared directly.
metric_definitions.uncertainty: Per-policy Wilson intervals concern episodes; train-seed variation is separately reported as sample standard deviation.

scope.gym_dynamics: so_rpy; cf2x_L250; 4D roll/pitch/yaw/collective-thrust policy with internal attitude response
scope.underactuation: Quadrotor horizontal force is coupled to tilt; these runs do not establish direct rotor control, fixed-wing support, or real-world transfer.
scope.landing: Official target is 0.1 m above ground, a near-ground hover rather than contact touchdown.
scope.optimality: Finite budgets and a plateau heuristic provide observed evidence, not a global upper-bound proof.
